ada-ha-bank-purchase|criteria/price-sani.subject: price-sanity
ada-ha-bank-purchase|criteria/price-sani.content: If a listing is more than ~30% below the cheapest official-store or Lazada price, flag it — likely counterfeit, grey import without local warranty, or a variant/price-bait trick.

ada-ha-bank-purchase|criteria/review-evi.subject: review-evidence
ada-ha-bank-purchase|criteria/review-evi.content: Prefer listings with 10+ reviews including buyer photos. Treat a perfect 5.0 rating with few reviews, or reviews that look templated, as a red flag rather than a positive.

ada-ha-bank-purchase|criteria/spec-verif.subject: spec-verification
ada-ha-bank-purchase|criteria/spec-verif.content: Cross-check claimed specs (capacity, wattage, chipset, materials) against the manufacturer's official page before a buy verdict. Misrepresented specs are the most common listing fraud.

ada-ha-bank-purchase|criteria/warranty.subject: warranty
ada-ha-bank-purchase|criteria/warranty.content: Electronics and powered devices must state a warranty (shop or brand). No warranty mention means caution at minimum; expensive items should carry brand warranty.
